tools.name: helix_create_workspace
tools.description: Create a Helix workspace the user owns, when they want a new one rather than one helix_list_workspaces lists. It comes with the free Helix plan a new Foundry workspace gets.

tools.name: helix_execute_admin_operation
tools.description: Run the change helix_prepare_admin_operation prepared: the same operation, target and payload, with its confirmation. A confirmation runs once, and the change is never retried.

tools.name: helix_execute_read_query
tools.description: Run one read query on a Helix database and return its JSON response. query_json is a Helix v3 JSON request, such as {"request_type":"read","query":{"read":{"entries":[{"query":{"name":"users","root":{"count":{"input":{"nodes_where":{"predicate":{"eq":{"left":{"property":"$label"},"right":{"constant"

tools.name: helix_execute_write_query
tools.description: Run the write query helix_prepare_write_query prepared: the same database and query_json, with its confirmation. A confirmation runs once, and the query is never retried.

tools.name: helix_feedback
tools.description: Send the Helix team feedback about these tools: a bug, a missing capability or a confusing result. Use it when a tool fails in a way you can't work around, or can't do what the task needs. At most 20 an hour.

tools.name: helix_foundry_ask
tools.description: Answer a question about a business from its Foundry ontology, with every claim citing the entities, facts, rows or document quotes it read: use it, in plain language, for questions about the user's customers, accounts, people, deals, documents or anything else their connected data holds. tools.name: helix_foundry_cancel_question
tools.description: Stop a queued or running Foundry question, so it spends no more of the workspace's question budget. A question that ended is returned as it is.

tools.name: helix_foundry_complete_document_upload
tools.description: After an upload_document action, once its bytes are PUT to the upload URL: check them and add the document to its document set, which every ontology whose current version reads the set then reads (reads says how). Completing twice is no error.

tools.name: helix_foundry_connect
tools.description: Connect a source to a workspace, or sign a connector in again: returns a link to Foundry for the user to open in their browser, so credentials never pass through the agent. A kind whose sign_in is true (helix_foundry_list_connector_kinds) connects by signing in at its provider: follow the result's s

tools.name: helix_foundry_create_use_case
tools.description: Create a use case of a Foundry ontology: an agent's task (such as answering support tickets) whose runs record what the agent read and wrote between its request and its answer. Start a run with helix_foundry_start_use_case_run each time the agent works on a request.

tools.name: helix_foundry_execute_operation
tools.description: Run the Foundry action helix_foundry_prepare_operation prepared: the same operation, target and payload, with its confirmation. A confirmation runs once, and the action is never retried. A client that can ask the person asks them first, and runs it only on their yes.

tools.name: helix_foundry_finish_use_case_run
tools.description: Finish a run of a Foundry use case with the agent's final answer, and its initial request if the run was started without it. A finished run records nothing more. Finishing again with the same answer is no error. A run that made calls with its id is assessed for how much the ontology helped; one that

tools.name: helix_foundry_get_ai_settings
tools.description: Get where a workspace's model calls go: the provider and models its generations, loads, questions and Founder, Foundry's own agent, run on (in_force), a saved provider waiting for its test (pending) or whose test failed (last_failed, with why), and whether Founder can run on each (assistant). tools.name: helix_foundry_get_context
tools.description: Learn what a business's Foundry ontology holds before you ask or read it: its schema (each type's properties, key, names and identifiers, and its links, rules and constraints) and example questions it answers, the ones Foundry suggests. It describes the version of the current load, which helix_found

tools.name: helix_foundry_get_dashboard
tools.description: Get one Foundry dashboard with its spec and revision. tools.name: helix_foundry_get_generation
tools.description: Get one generation of a Foundry ontology, or a revision of one of its versions with the engine's result once it ended. tools.name: helix_foundry_get_load
tools.description: Get one load of a Foundry ontology with its newest jobs (the load that writes it, and extracts that add documents to it): their status, phase, progress, error and spend. documents counts what it made of its documents, in all and by document set: how many a model read, how many its version does not r

tools.name: helix_foundry_get_ontology
tools.description: Get one Foundry ontology: its current version, versions, loads and generations, and the workspace's document sets: those its current version was given (document_sets) and the rest (other_document_sets). tools.name: helix_foundry_get_question
tools.description: Get a question asked of a Foundry ontology, waiting up to 25 seconds for it to finish.

tools.name: helix_foundry_get_sign_in
tools.description: Get a connector sign-in: pending, authorizing, finishing, connected (with the connector), declined, failed (with a fixed failure code) or expired. With wait, waits up to 25 s while it isn't done; call again until it is.

tools.name: helix_foundry_get_sync
tools.description: Get one sync of a Foundry connector, with its status, rows and error. With wait, waits up to 25 s while it runs; call again until it ends.

tools.name: helix_foundry_get_use_case_run
tools.description: Get a run of a Foundry use case with the calls it recorded, 100 at a time: each read with its result, question, send with its pieces' ids, and upload.

tools.name: helix_foundry_get_version
tools.description: Get one version of a Foundry ontology with its definition (such as a generation's draft before it is made current) and load_refusal: why create_load would refuse it, absent when it would load it. document_set_ids are the sets it was given; document_reads says which of them its routes read (read_set_

tools.name: helix_foundry_get_workflow
tools.description: Get one Foundry workflow with its spec and revision. A spec is a graph: {"v": 1, "nodes": [...], "edges": [{"from", "to", "branch"}]}, at most 50 nodes and 100 edges. A node is {"id": 1 to 32 lowercase letters, digits, - or _, starting with a letter or digit, "kind", "config", "position": {"x", "y"}

tools.name: helix_foundry_get_workflow_run
tools.description: Get one run of a Foundry workflow with each step it ran: its status, output and error.

tools.name: helix_foundry_list_connector_kinds
tools.description: List the kinds of connector Foundry offers a workspace, and whether its plan includes each: a Foundry Pro kind is unavailable without Pro. helix_foundry_connect connects one, a kind with sign_in by signing in at its provider and any other through its form; an API source (events) has no credential, s

tools.name: helix_foundry_list_connectors
tools.description: List a workspace's Foundry connectors with their synced tables and newest sync. Credentials are never returned. tools.name: helix_foundry_list_dashboards
tools.description: List a workspace's Foundry dashboards, pinned ones first: each a set of tiles, typed queries of ontologies' loads shown as tables and charts, which every member sees and reads as themselves. Specs are left out: helix_foundry_get_dashboard reads one.

tools.name: helix_foundry_list_documents
tools.description: List the documents a Foundry ontology reads, with what extracting each into the current load made of it; or every document of one of the workspace's document sets. A document with source is a connector's, the text of one row of its table: it can't be renamed, moved or deleted, and new text at the so

tools.name: helix_foundry_list_ontologies
tools.description: Start here to use what a business knows: Helix Foundry holds its customers, accounts, people, deals, documents and the facts that link them, matched across its systems into ontologies whose every fact names its source. List the Foundry ontologies of one workspace, with their current version and load

tools.name: helix_foundry_list_questions
tools.description: List the questions asked of a Foundry ontology, or of one thread, newest first and without their answers, with the workspace's question budget.

tools.name: helix_foundry_list_review_decisions
tools.description: List the review decisions settled on a Foundry ontology: the overrides each load after them applies. tools.name: helix_foundry_list_reviews
tools.description: List the reviews a Foundry ontology's current load holds: what its documents state that it didn't write as it stands. A name it matched to no one record (settle resolve, with its candidates), a property its documents state differently (prop, with each value and its quote), or a statement it held bac

tools.name: helix_foundry_list_use_cases
tools.description: List a Foundry ontology's use cases, newest first, with how many runs each kept. A use case of origin workflow is Foundry's record of a workflow's runs that use the ontology: only Foundry starts and finishes its runs.

tools.name: helix_foundry_list_workflow_runs
tools.description: List one Foundry workflow's runs, newest first: their status, what fired them, their spend and error.

tools.name: helix_foundry_list_workflows
tools.description: List a workspace's Foundry workflows: graphs of steps Foundry runs as their owner when a schedule fires or a sync, load, upload or draft ends, each with its newest run. Specs are left out: helix_foundry_get_workflow reads one.

tools.name: helix_foundry_prepare_operation
tools.description: Check a Foundry action and return a one-time confirmation for exactly that action, valid for five minutes; helix_foundry_execute_operation runs it. Preparing changes nothing. A create_ontology on workspace:<id> makes the ontology's database first, and its project when new.

tools.name: helix_foundry_preview_dashboard_tile
tools.description: Check a dashboard tile and read its query once, as you, before you put it in a dashboard: returns its output, or why it has none. tools.name: helix_foundry_read_graph
tools.description: Look up exact records in a business's Foundry ontology: typed queries over its entities and facts, the evidence and source behind a fact, why a derived fact holds, and rule breaks, read from a load with its version's rules applied. 1 to 20 reads in one call; helix_foundry_read_guide gives their JSON

tools.name: helix_foundry_read_guide
tools.description: Describe the reads helix_foundry_read_graph takes: their kinds and JSON Schema.

tools.name: helix_foundry_recall
tools.description: Recall what was remembered in a business's Foundry API source: the notes that agents and people sent it with helix_foundry_send_pieces, newest first, from the moment each is sent, before any ontology has read it. tools.name: helix_foundry_start_use_case_run
tools.description: Start a run of a Foundry use case when the agent takes on a request. Pass the run's id as use_case_run_id to helix_foundry_read_graph, helix_foundry_ask, helix_foundry_send_pieces and helix_foundry_complete_document_upload while working on it: each records what it read or wrote under the run. Finish

tools.name: helix_get_cluster_health
tools.description: Get CPU, memory, storage and topology for one dedicated cluster over a time window. Each part reports whether it is available on its own.

tools.name: helix_get_database_usage
tools.description: Get hourly or daily read and write counts for one database over a time window.

tools.name: helix_get_query_insights
tools.description: Get per-query statistics for one database over a time window: how often each query ran and failed, its average and maximum latency, and what the query planner found. Latency percentiles are helix_get_query_latency's, and recommendations helix_list_query_recommendations's.

tools.name: helix_get_query_latency
tools.description: Get query latency percentiles, p99 included, for one database over a time window: overall, or by query.

tools.name: helix_get_started
tools.description: Start using Helix before the user has an account: create or return this agent registration's one-month Helix sandbox, a workspace with a project and a database, which the user claims with their email as auth.md describes.

tools.name: helix_list_database_indexes
tools.description: List the indexes one database's queries can use now, as its writer reports them. A build still running or blocked isn't listed: check it with a GetIndexOperation read of the operation_id its DDL returned, through helix_execute_read_query, then retry or abort it with a RetryIndexOperation or AbortInd

tools.name: helix_list_database_keys
tools.description: List the gateway keys of one database: each key's id, name, permissions and status. A key's secret is returned only once, by create_database_key; Helix's own operational keys are never listed.

tools.name: helix_list_databases
tools.description: List the databases of one project: dedicated clusters (cluster:<id>) and databases on the shared cluster (tenant:<id>), each with the reference the query tools take.

tools.name: helix_list_projects
tools.description: List the projects of one workspace that the user may read.

tools.name: helix_list_query_recommendations
tools.description: List the current query recommendations for one database, each with its whole MDX body.

tools.name: helix_list_workspaces
tools.description: List the Helix workspaces the user belongs to. A workspace holds projects, and a project databases, Foundry's among them. A user with only one workspace may leave workspace_id empty everywhere; helix_create_workspace makes a new one.

tools.name: helix_prepare_admin_operation
tools.description: Check a change to a database or its keys and return a one-time confirmation for exactly that change, valid for five minutes; helix_execute_admin_operation runs it. Preparing changes nothing.

tools.name: helix_prepare_write_query
tools.description: Check a Helix v3 write query and return a one-time confirmation for exactly that query, valid for five minutes; helix_execute_write_query runs it. Preparing changes nothing.
